text:
Olivia (PM): Drafting rollout plan for `latency-aware regional fallback` feature. Goal: reduce p95 spikes in regions by routing affected traffic to quantized / cached model variant automatically when latency or error thresholds hit. Asking for canary schedule, gating metrics, kill-switches, and customer opt-out handling.

Sam (Eng Lead): +1. Need clarity on model-compatibility mapping and stateful sessions (KV cache) behavior. If we swap variants mid-session we must preserve context.

Mira (Infra): For regional routing we'll use the existing smart-routing policy. Suggest sequence: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with telemetry gates at each step. Can we add a warmup shadow for 24h before first percent?

Daniel (SRE): Key SLOs to gate on: p95 latency, 5xx rate, tail CPU on inference hosts. Propose gates: p95 < 450ms AND 5xx < 0.2% for 12h before next step. If p95 > 800ms or 5xx > 1% -> auto rollback/fallback. Also add manual kill-switch for tenants.

Priya (Product Ops): Customer impact: enterprise tenants need opt-out + notice. We should add a fortnight-long opt-in window for customers flagged as high-sensitivity. Also update docs and support KB before 10% stage.

Carlos (CS): For key accounts, add a pre-rollout heads-up and an opt-out flag `feature.fallback.routing.tenant_<id>.disabled`. They expect preserved model outputs — so include a rollback transcript capture.

Olivia (PM): Good notes. Putting proposal details below. Please thumbs up if you agree or reply with objections.

Olivia (PM): Proposed canary schedule:
```
Phase 0 - Shadow run: 24h across all regions (no traffic switched) -> collect quality/latency metrics
Phase 1 - Micro canary: 0.5% traffic in target region for 6h -> check gates
Phase 2 - Small canary: 2% for 12h -> check gates
Phase 3 - Controlled ramp: 10% for 24h -> check gates + support on-call
Phase 4 - Wide ramp: 50% for 24h -> more telemetry checks
Phase 5 - Full switch: 100% if all gates pass
```
Gating criteria: p95 latency delta vs baseline < +15%, 5xx delta < +0.2pp, token cost change monitored (expected -10% to -30%). Rollback triggers documented.

Sam (Eng Lead): On swapping variants mid-session: implement sticky routing for sessions with active KV caches. i.e., once a session is opened to a variant, route same session to same variant until end-of-session or explicit cache flush. Will need a small change to routing table TTLs.

Mira (Infra): Config snippet for the feature flag and routing policy (example):
```
{
  "flag": "latency_regional_fallback",
  "targets": [
    {"region": "eu-west-1", "variant": "redwood-v2-quant", "weight": 0.005},
    {"region": "eu-west-1", "variant": "redwood-v2-quant", "weight": 0.02}
  ],
  "sticky_sessions": true,
  "shadow": true
}
```
This will be set per-region and per-tenant override keys.

Daniel (SRE): Add automated runbook hooks: when gate fails, we run `rw fallback enact --region eu-west-1 --reason p95_spike` which flips routing back and notifies #incidents and the on-call. Also capture 1h of request/response pairs for debugging. QA-bot please validate capture compliance.

QA-bot: Will run privacy scan for captured transcripts. We will redact PII and store in secure bucket with limited retention (30 days).

Carlos (CS): For enterprise legal: need opt-out logging per tenant and audit trail. Also provide a toggled preview endpoint for customers to test fallback outputs against baseline before we flip traffic.

Priya (Product Ops): Launch checklist items (short):
- Docs + support KB updated
- Customer opt-out API ready
- On-call rota assigned for first 72h of ramp
- Metric dashboards: p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, cost per token, quality regression alerts
- Postmortem template ready

Sam (Eng Lead): Can we add a small A/B evaluation for quality drift? Shadow some % of requests to both variants and compute BLEU/ROUGE-like signal + business metric proxy for 24h pre-ramp. If drift > threshold, abort.

Olivia (PM): Yes — add evaluation window pre-Phase 1. We'll require quality-safety gate pass. QA to define thresholds.

Daniel (SRE): Ops play: if we detect oscillation (flip-flop) of routing >3 times in 6h, auto-disable the feature globally and page infra lead.

Mira (Infra): Storage point: add KV cache versioning to ensure compatibility across variants. If mismatch detected, force session fallback to original variant and mark tenant for migration.

Olivia (PM): Next steps: Sam and Mira to produce change list for sticky sessions + flag schema by EOD Thursday. Daniel to draft runbook automations. Priya to coordinate customer notices. QA-bot to run privacy / quality probes. We'll circle back Friday 11am PT for sign-off.

Sam (Eng Lead): Working on it, assigned ticket ENG-8812.

Mira (Infra): Assigned INF-7721 for routing TTL + KV versioning.

deploy-bot: New prod flag `latency_regional_fallback` created in staging by Olivia at 2024-05-14T16:12:10Z :rocket:

Olivia (PM): Thanks everyone — please add comments if blocked. :thumbsup:
